description: This file defines the Vacancy entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, mapping to the 'ohrm_job_vacancy' database table. It includes properties such as id, jobTitle, hiringManager, name, description, number of positions, status, publication status, and timestamps, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Vacancy
classes.description: Entity class representing a job vacancy, with ORM mappings and associated properties for the HRM system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the vacancy.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the vacancy.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Returns the job title associated with the vacancy.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Sets the job title for the vacancy.

methods.name: getHiringManager
methods.description: Returns the hiring manager, if set.

methods.name: setHiringManager
methods.description: Assigns a hiring manager to the vacancy.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name/title of the vacancy.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name/title of the vacancy.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the vacancy.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the vacancy.

methods.name: getNumOfPositions
methods.description: Returns the number of positions available for the vacancy.

methods.name: setNumOfPositions
methods.description: Sets the number of positions for the vacancy.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the vacancy is active.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the activity status of the vacancy.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Returns whether the vacancy is published in the feed.

methods.name: setIsPublished
methods.description: Sets the publication status of the vacancy.

methods.name: getDefinedTime
methods.description: Returns the date/time when the vacancy was defined.

methods.name: setDefinedTime
methods.description: Sets the date/time when the vacancy was defined.

methods.name: getUpdatedTime
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp for the vacancy.

methods.name: setUpdatedTime
methods.description: Updates the last modified timestamp of the vacancy.
